notes: Single file (main article, 7 pages); no supplementary information supplied. I1 judged met: the paper reports its own gas-phase H2 uptake isotherms (wt% vs pressure to 100 bar, Fig. 7) and a 77 K, 85 bar uptake-vs-time run (Fig. 8), but it never names the instrument or method (gravimetric vs volumetric); 'equilibrium pressure' suggests a pressure-composition (volumetric) measurement. Not computed, not electrochemical, not TPD. Carbon sorbent: pure MWCNTs measured (0.635 wt% at 74 bar); the temperature of the MWCNT curve is not stated separately, but the 77 K, 85 bar value is stated for the MWCNT-ZnO(complex) composite (Abstract; p. 6, 'The effect of time on storage ability'). Composites contain ZnO; carbon mass fraction not reported. Exclusion follows from I4 alone: no specific surface area is reported for any sample. Not a review/thesis/patent; record is_retracted false and no retraction notice in PDF; no statement that the uptake data were published before.
